q1_independent_mujoco_world_frame_refere.detail: The C3-S2 static fixture seal provides world-frame site poses for 8 static fixtures, validated via MuJoCo model queries. The C1-V2 registry maps BDDL targets to MuJoCo entity IDs. However, these are model-level, not per-episode. For per-step verification, the sidecar object_state provides body world poses (including basket_1_main), but site world poses (sim.data.site_xpos) are NOT recorded in the sidecar and require either MuJoCo replay or body→site reconstruction.
available_sources: C3-S2 STATIC_WORLD_POSE_SEAL — 8 static fixture world poses
C1-V2 registry — entity IDs, sizes, parent relationships
Sidecar object_state — body world poses (including basket_1_main)
missing_for_per_episode: sim.data.site_xpos per step (requires MuJoCo init + replay)

q2_static_fixture_offline_verification.answer: YES — but limited to seal-validated fixtures
q2_static_fixture_offline_verification.detail: Static fixtures classified as STATIC_EXACT_SITE in C3-S2 can be verified offline by comparing their seal world poses against reconstructed poses from sidecar object_state. The parent body pose is in object_state (e.g., flat_stove_1_burner for flat_stove_1_cook_region). The reconstruction uses: site_world = seal_mean_xpos (constant). Divergence from this constant across episodes indicates non-static behavior. However, for the 2 DYNAMIC_POSSIBLE_UNSEALED fixtures (white_cabinet, wooden_cabinet), offline verification is not possible — their poses depend on unrecorded hinge joint angles.
q2_static_fixture_offline_verification.method: Compare C3-S2 seal mean_xpos/mean_xmat against null model (constant pose hypothesis)

q3_dynamic_support_body_site_reconstruct.answer: YES — for basket and other body+site fixtures
q3_dynamic_support_body_site_reconstruct.detail: Basket body pose (basket_1_main) is available in object_state at every step via slice specs from BDDL parsing. The C3-S2 seal validated the body→site reconstruction: site_world = body_xpos + body_xmat @ site_local_pos with max error 0.0 across 5 canonical states. This reconstruction can be applied per-step using the sidecar body pose. For non-basket dynamic fixtures without validated local transforms, the reconstruction is NOT available.
q3_dynamic_support_body_site_reconstruct.validation: C3-S2 basket reconstruction seal — max position error 0.0, tolerance 1e-6

white_cabinet_1_bottom_region.episodes_affected: libero_10/task_03 — all 50 states. Pick-and-place tasks targeting white cabinet bottom shelf.

wooden_cabinet_1_top_region.episodes_affected: libero_goal/task_03 — all 50 states. Goal-conditioned tasks targeting wooden cabinet top.

q4_articulated_unknown_tasks.observability_status: UNKNOWN — hinge joint angles not recorded in sidecar; world pose of cabinet-mounted sites depends on unobservable joint state

static_position_max_error.method: Compare C3-S2 seal mean_xpos against reconstructed site pose from sidecar body pose
static_position_max_error.limitation: Requires body pose for each static fixture's parent body in object_state. Some parent bodies (e.g., table, wine_rack_1_main) may not be in object_state slices.

static_rotation_max_error.method: Compare C3-S2 seal mean_xmat against sidecar body_xmat for parent body
static_rotation_max_error.limitation: Same body availability constraint as position.

dynamic_position_p99.method: Reconstruct basket site pose from sidecar body pose across all basket-task episodes, compute per-step reconstruction error against seal-validated model
dynamic_position_p99.limitation: Without ground-truth site_xpos, error is relative to reconstruction model, not absolute.

dynamic_rotation_p99.method: Same as position — relative to body orientation. Basket typically has near-identity rotation, so error is dominated by body quaternion noise.

q5_telemetry_sufficiency.absolute_ground_truth: NOT available without MuJoCo replay. Sidecar does not record sim.data.site_xpos/xmat.

q7_recorded_action_modeless_replay.answer: PARTIALLY — works for non-fixture-contact episodes, fails for contact-sensitive trajectories
q7_recorded_action_modeless_replay.detail: C2R0 demonstrated: 3/4 sampled episodes achieve exact numerical parity (0 EEF/qpos/object issues) using canonical init state + recorded actions. However, task_09 (microwave fixture) shows systematic divergence at step 136 due to contact dynamics amplifying sub-pixel EEF offset. For C3-S3 purposes: static fixture episodes can use C3-S2 seal directly (no replay needed); basket episodes can use body→site reconstruction from sidecar (no replay needed); white/wooden cabinet episodes require replay of hinge joint angles, which is NOT available from sidecar alone.
replay_feasible_for: Non-fixture-contact episodes — exact parity confirmed (3/3 sampled)
Static fixture episodes — use C3-S2 seal, no replay needed
Basket episodes — use body→site reconstruction, no replay needed
replay_not_feasible_for: White/wooden cabinet episodes — hinge angles not recorded
minimum_requirements_for_full_replay: Canonical init state bytes (not just SHA)
Acceptance of sub-pixel divergence for contact-sensitive trajectories

development_recommendations: 1. Static fixtures (8): use C3-S2 seal directly for world pose — no per-episode replay needed for these
2. Basket (13 task instances): use sidecar body pose + validated local transform for per-step site pose
3. White/wooden cabinet (2 tasks): mark as UNOBSERVABLE in per-episode evaluation — hinge angles not in sidecar
4. For absolute ground-truth validation: implement MuJoCo replay with canonical init states on a sample of non-fixture episodes
5. P99 dynamic error: compute from basket reconstruction across all 13 task instances × 50 states = 650 episodes
